summary: Tested the OnTheAir REST API mode alongside HyperDeck mode. Backend: tests/test_ota.py was rewritten for ota_mode; 17/17 pass (settings validation, invalid ota_mode -> 422, mode field in /api/status, API-mode clips and countdowns, one API port (8089) unreachable, switching api<->hyperdeck, and API mode pointed at HyperDeck ports). Frontend (Playwright, 1920x1080): /ota in API mode shows 'Promo Meci 8081/8082/8083', ON AIR badges and decreasing countdowns; footer reads 'REST API 127.0.0.1 · 8081 / 8082 / 8083' and 'OnTheAir 3/3 connected'. In /settings the mode toggle auto-fills ports (8081-3 / 9993-5) and the label changes (Port API / Port HyperDeck). Saving HyperDeck mode makes /ota show 'Reportaj Stiri 999X.mov' with a HYPERDECK footer; switching back to API works. Port 8089 on output 2 shows only that panel as 'Offline :8089' and 'OnTheAir 2/3 connected'. CPU stayed near 0% while the port was unreachable. Regression: / and /vmix render; vMix offline is expected.

minor.issue: ota_mode defaults to 'api' in SettingsIn, so a client that leaves out ota_mode (older UI or script) silently switches the app to API mode. Making the field required, or keeping the current OTA_MODE when it is missing, would be safer.

issues: The EMPTY_OUTPUTS placeholder uses HyperDeck ports 9993-9995 while the footer label defaults to 'REST API', so the first paint can briefly read 'REST API — · 9993 / 9994 / 9995'. Cosmetic only.

action_items: Optional: make ota_mode required in PUT /api/settings, or keep the current mode when it is missing
Optional: set the OtaDisplay EMPTY_OUTPUTS placeholder ports to 8081-8083 to match the default API mode
critical_code_review_comments: ota_api_poll/ota_poll_loop: restart-event handling is correct; mode switches take effect in under 0.3s and errors back off for 2s (no busy loop)
ota_clip_from_api handles missing item_remaining with total - elapsed, and falls back to alternate key names - good defensive mapping
tests/backend_test.py TestVmix (5 tests) fails only because the vMix mock is not running and real vMix 172.16.50.25 is unreachable. Expected per the brief, not a regression

success_rate.backend: 100% (17/17 OTA tests; vMix tests skipped: offline expected)
